## Global Error Handler

🎯 **Purpose:** Catches any errors that occur in ALL other active workflows. If a workflow fails (e.g. API down, bad credentials), this workflow immediately sends a Telegram alert to the owner.

🔄 **Runs:** Automatically whenever any active workflow errors out.

⚠️ **Setup:** You MUST set the "Error Workflow" setting in each individual workflow's settings to point to this workflow.

⚠️ **Error Trigger**
Listens for execution failures across your n8n instance.

✍️ **Format Error Message**
Extracts the name of the workflow that failed and the specific error message.

📱 **Send Owner Alert**
Instantly notifies you on Telegram so you know immediately if an automation breaks.
